items.question: What ritual repetition must be completed by the one worshipped by gods?
premises: The action involves performing a hundred thousand repetitions.
These repetitions are situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
The instruction is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: A hundred thousand repetitions situated in the forehead's syllable-mass must be performed.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the repetition or practice denoted by lakṣaṃ is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
